{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "alarms_cleared",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "On those older units: disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again. Don't reboot the whole unit unless that fails.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Did that. Traffic is back 👍",
    "about_entity": "TRN-087"
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a reusable rule to bounce the interface rather than rebooting when link is up, alarms are cleared, and counters stay at zero after an SFP replacement on older units."
}
